vendor_highlights: Released gemini-2.5-pro-exp-03-25, a public experimental Gemini model with thinking mode always on by default.

changelog.text:
*   **Gemini 2.5 Pro deprecation**:
  [`gemini-2.5-pro`](/docs/models/gemini-2.5-pro) is
  [deprecated](/docs/deprecations#gemini-2.5-pro-models) and is no longer
  available to select in Google AI Studio. Effective December 1, 2026, all API
  requests to `gemini-2.5-pro` will automatically route to
  [`gemini-3.8-flash`](/docs/models/gemini-3.8-flash) and be billed at
  [Gemini 3.8 Flash rates](/docs/pricing#gemini-3.8-flash). Before December 1,
  2026, update your model string to `gemini-3.8-flash` and review the
  [Gemini 3.8 Flash migration guide](/docs/whats-new-gemini-3.8#migrate-to-gemini-3-8-flash).
  Breaking API changes include function calling and `thought_signature`
  validation, `thinking_level` replacing `thinking_budget`, and removed
  sampling parameters and prefilled model turns.

*   Launched enhancements to our [text-to-speech
  models](/docs/speech-generation), Gemini 2.5 Flash TTS preview (optimized
  for low latency) and Gemini 2.5 Pro TTS preview (optimized for quality),
  including enhanced expressivity, precision pacing, and seamless dialogue.

*     The preview models `gemini-2.5-pro-preview-05-06` and
  `gemini-2.5-pro-preview-03-25` are now redirecting to the latest stable
  version `gemini-2.5-pro`.

*     Released `gemini-2.5-pro`, the stable version of our most powerful model,
  now with adaptive thinking. To learn more, see [Gemini 2.5
  Pro](/docs/models#gemini-25-pro) and [Thinking](/docs/thinking).
  `gemini-2.5-pro-preview-05-06` will be redirected to `gemini-2.5-pro` on
  June 26, 2025.

*   Released `gemini-2.5-pro-preview-06-05`, a new version of our most powerful
  model, now with adaptive thinking. To learn more, see [Gemini 2.5 Pro
  Preview](/docs/models) and
  [Thinking](/docs/thinking). `gemini-2.5-pro-preview-05-06` will be
  redirected to `gemini-2.5-pro` on June 26, 2025.

*   Released `gemini-2.5-pro-preview-03-25`, a public preview Gemini 2.5 Pro
  version with billing enabled. You can continue to use
  `gemini-2.5-pro-exp-03-25` on sthe free tier.

*   Released `gemini-2.5-pro-exp-03-25`, a public experimental Gemini model with
  thinking mode always on by default. To learn more, see [Gemini 2.5 Pro
  Experimental](/docs/models).
